name: What does it mean when a home listing expires?

mainEntity.name: What does it mean when a home listing expires?

acceptedAnswer.text: An expired home listing means the property did not sell within the timeframe specified in the listing agreement between the homeowner and their real estate agent. When a listing expires, the agreement is terminated, and the agent no longer has the legal right to market or sell the property. Homeowners in areas like Miami-Dade or Broward County often reassess their selling strategy, property condition, or agent partnership at this point. This can lead to re-listing with the same agent, choosing a new agent, or deciding to take the property off the market entirely.
acceptedAnswer.description: An expired listing means the property did not sell within the agreed-upon contract period with the real estate agent.
